featured_reviews.name: hevita martis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sumit’s Academy of dance is truly amazing! The instructor, Sumit, is highly skilled, friendly, and genuinely passionate about teaching. He encourages us at every step, making each class fun, engaging, and well-structured to help us improve our dance technique while building confidence. The choreography is creative, and the performances are always beautifully organized, giving students a wonderful opportunity to showcase their hard work. Sumit’s Academy of dance is definitely the place to be!
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Dear_ My blue
featured_reviews.review_text:
I came all the way from Korea and had such an amazing experience here. From the moment I arrived, everyone was incredibly kind, welcoming, and friendly.

As someone who had very little experience with Bollywood dance, I was a bit nervous at first, but the instructor made me feel comfortable right away. The choreography was broken down step by step in a way that was easy to understand, and the teaching style was patient, encouraging, and fun throughout the entire lesson.

What impressed me the most was how passionate and energetic the instructor was. The class never felt intimidating, and I found myself enjoying every minute while learning something completely new. Even as a beginner, I was able to follow along and gain confidence by the end of the session.

I was also filming a travel vlog during my visit, and they were very accommodating and supportive. The atmosphere was positive, professional, and full of good energy.

This has been one of the most memorable experiences of my trip to India. If you’re visiting Mumbai and want to experience authentic Bollywood dance, I highly recommend taking a class here. Thank you for making my time in India so special. I will definitely remember this experience and hope to come back again in the future!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Highly recommended! 💃✨🇮🇳🇰🇷

featured_reviews.name: 13 Anisha
featured_reviews.review_text:
The dance instructor is absolutely amazing—so full of energy and positivity that every class feels exciting and uplifting! Sumit sir is incredibly encouraging, constantly motivating everyone to do their best while making the whole experience fun and stress-free.

What truly stands out is how beautifully they break down each step, making even the most challenging moves feel easy to learn. Their focus, patience, and attention to every student really help build confidence and improve skills. Overall, it’s such a joyful and rewarding experience. I always leave class with a big smile!

Highly recommend this class to everyone be it a beginner or advanced level dancer.

featured_reviews.name: titus martin
featured_reviews.review_text: Sumit Academy of Dance had done a thorough and professional job during the summer camp for my wife and daughter. In just five days they went from shaking a leg to performing on stage in a well coordinated dance group with costumes. The choreography was for all ages, creative, fun and top notch. Thank you so much for bringing out the inner dancer in us. Will definitely try to join again.

featured_reviews.name: Matt Fernald
featured_reviews.review_text: We visited Mumbai for one week. We wanted a dance class, and Sumit made it easy for us. Great communication on WhatsApp. Recommended a class that would work for our schedule and our novice status. Thank you, Sumit!

featured_reviews.name: ranesa sawhney
featured_reviews.review_text: I had such an amazing experience at Sumit’s Dance Academy! It was honestly so much fun from start to finish. The energy in every class is incredible, and you can really feel how passionate the instructors are about dance. I learned so much in such a short time not just new moves, but also confidence, expression, and technique. The environment is super positive and welcoming, which makes it even more enjoyable to learn and grow.

featured_reviews.name: Ullash Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've tried many dance forms in the past, but today I have realized that nothing and no dance form has made me feel as beautiful & powerful as what bellydance has made me feel ❤. Positive energy in abundance in every class, along with encouragement and pure fun. The teacher has an amazing eye for detail — she corrects posture ( most important ), hands, hips, knees, feet, shoulders everything… but in such a motivating and entertaining way that you actually enjoy learning.

There is big difference in my flexibility, body confidence & grace.
Don’t hesitate about your age, your body, about anything- just join.
This isn’t just dance… it’s therapy in motion. 💃✨
In one line -
These belly dance classes are a total confidence booster shots 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Fashionby Sim
featured_reviews.review_text:
This belly dance class has honestly become one of the best parts of my week. The teacher pays so much attention to every small detail — seriously, her observation is too good. She notices the tiniest things and helps each of us improve. She really works on every student individually, and I really appreciate that.

The learning space she gives us is also very nice — very open, very positive. Yahan hum sirf dance nahi seekhte… we learn, we improve, we laugh. I’ve grown a lot in terms of confidence because of this class. Belly dance ke through I feel more connected to myself, and that feels really good.

And I have to say, my batchmates are amazing. I feel like I’ve found such good people here — even good friends. Dancing with them makes the class even more fun.

Overall, this class has given me growth, happiness, and a lot of comfort. I really enjoy coming here, and I’m very grateful to the teacher for creating such a warm and supportive space.

featured_reviews.name: Andrew Pillai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Energy is something that means everything to me and this class has the right energy for me ❤ . Then I would say the music and the teaching style are unmatched. All steps are broken down so clearly that even a beginner feels confident within the first session. Energy of the class is not just fun and feminine but empowering as well — you don’t just learn belly dance, you learn grace, posture, rhythm and body awareness.

The instructor pays personal attention to each student & brings out the best in every one.
I look forward to every class — it’s my favourite part of the week! 💃🩷

featured_reviews.name: Rajni Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: Have reached level 11. Doing the professional choreography currently and feeling awesome. I have enjoyed learning here. The personal training sessions are a lot of fun and great learning at the same time. I eventually to intend to also teach belly dance someday myself and I will start my teachers training course also very soon here with Ritambhara ma'am. I definitely recommend this class to anyone who loves this dance form as its taught perfectly well here.

featured_reviews.name: umama indorewala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I should instead have joined a martial arts class and stepped away in the begining when I was asked to make all payments in advance with little detailing of the classes themselves. Miss Ritu has a nice attitude when she's your teacher, but not as a saleswoman.
Oh and you guys better not get sick or have a family member die on the day of the class, cause you're not getting your money back or the class rescheduled.
I was not forced to buy a belt though, like the other comments mention. Maybe because they were private classes?

featured_reviews.name: Tanya Mohan
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been to other belly dance classes near me but somehow din't connect anywhere. I tried this class and I have stuck here and currently I am on level 4. So, what I primarily love about this class is the pace at which Rita mam teaches. It's only me who calls her Rita ( Ritambhara). I understood each and every technique in a new light and I finally understood the belly dance techniques and came more closer to the dance art. My foundation in belly dancing has become really strong because of the way its taught. Also I'm so happy with my belly dancing belt. They taught me how to choose a belt that was appropriate for me which no other teacher ever taught me. The sound of the belt motivates me so much and makes my learning better. In each and every class I assure you each and every person will get the personal attention they need from the teacher and the practice is so awesome. I also achieved my hand and leg  coordination which I achieved no where in the previous belly dance classes. Also I'm so happy that I was also taught how to dance to a Shakira song apart from other belly dance songs. Of course I have to be better than what I am today and I know I can acheive it just here at these belly dance classes in Mumbai. I do recommend ❤️

featured_reviews.name: confetti confetti
featured_reviews.review_text: I really like the belly dance classes here essentially because of the personalised attention I'm getting from the teacher. I'm liking the fact that if I make any mistake its understood and rectified then and there. Definitely the way belly dance is taught here is very stimulating for me. I am also having fun at the same time. I would like to add that belly dance has really made me feel very confident about my body. I have build amazing confidence with this dance form. Almost done with level 1 and looking forward to level 2. 💃💃

featured_reviews.name: Mitu Daga
featured_reviews.review_text:
Belly Dancing at Belly Dance Institute Mumbai has been an experience beyond just learning—it’s a journey of self-expression, confidence, and joy. Each class is a blend of fun, engagement, and discovery, where learning feels effortless and every technique is enjoyed to its fullest.

The instructor is calm, humorous, and very knowledgeable. She breaks down even the most intricate movements into their simplest forms, which has made learning so easy. Not just a teacher, but she is a mentor, a guru, and a friend, radiating warmth, positivity, and kindness that makes my energy uplifting and positive.

A sense of connection—not just with dance but with my own feminine energy is what I feel here. Every session feels meditative, allowing me to embrace grace, strength, and rhythm in a way that is both empowering and transformative.

Grateful 🙏 to have found this institute and the happiness it brings into my life. If you’re looking for more than just a belly dance class—if you seek an experience that nurtures your body, mind, and spirit—Belly Dance Institute Mumbai is the place to be.

featured_reviews.name: Komal Gilder
featured_reviews.review_text: I attended a Garba class in 2019 years back and recently a bollywood sundowner dance session with Magic of Tarantism, taught by the incredibly talented duo, Trupti and Bhakti. Their grace and expertise in dance are truly remarkable. They have a unique way of breaking down the techniques, making it easy for even non-dancers to catch on and enjoy the process. The choice of songs and the choreography they select are not only classy but also perfect for performing at any dignified event. Dancing with them brought me immense joy and fun. I am eagerly looking forward to many more dance lessons with these amazing instructors. If you are looking to learn dance and have a great time, I highly recommend Magic of Tarantism!

featured_reviews.name: Divya Vaswani
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a brilliant time with Trupti and Bhakti. They choreographed for my in-laws who danced at 80 and for my husband & me. They were so good with the steps and the song selection. They are a lovely duo ❤️❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been learning with Bhakti and Trupti for over 4 years now.
I don’t live in Mumbai, but make it a point to come here and learn from them on every trip.
They are fab with their choreographies, always on time, extremely accommodating/ flexible and the list goes on.
But most importantly, the way they teach is commendable. Even if one is a non dancer they will make sure you become one.
Always a pleasure learning with them.
Trupti and Bhakti always ROCK !! ❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Vatsal Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text: We were introduced to Trupti and Bhakti through mutual friends who had used them at their wedding. Our situation was quite different in that we needed virtual help from halfway across the world but it worked out really for us. They were super responsive to our questions and requests, created step-by-step choreography video tutorials for us, and were even willing to provide virtual live sessions with us and our family and friends by request. They adjusted the level of difficulty of the dances based on our preferences too and we are so glad they were able to work with us to bring our sangeet vision to reality. We will be spreading the the word about their good work far and wide to our friends in the US and India, and we look forward to working with them in the future too 🙂

featured_reviews.name: Krushi Barfiwala
featured_reviews.review_text: Trupti and Bhakti are patient, super fun and a great energy to have around especially when there is a lot of wedding stress doing the rounds. Their choreography is fresh, delicate and graceful. Loved it so much with them after Sangeet practise that even joined their weekly batch to learn dance. Best Wishes to Magic or Tarantism🌸💝

featured_reviews.name: Phalguni Jiwane
featured_reviews.review_text: It has been a pleasure having Jyoti Ma’am as a teacher and mentor. She knows how to strike a perfect balance between a taskmaster and good company. Her pedagogy is beginner friendly initially which gradually moves to intermediate with time and practice. Her style is a blend of Bharatnatyam and Kathak for the most part along with some folk choreography. Highly recommended for working professionals and college students working/studying in and around South Bombay. Its a great opportunity to unwind after a tiring day and staying active, while aalso exploring hobbies or honing one’s skills.

featured_reviews.name: Shahzneen Bschool
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve had a wonderful experience learning classical dance under Jyoti ma'am's guidance. She is incredibly patient and ensures that every movement is taught in a detailed and systematic manner. Her classes are well-structured, and she takes the time to correct each student with care, helping us understand not just the steps but the essence behind them. I truly appreciate her dedication and the positive learning environment she creates. Highly recommended for anyone looking to build a strong foundation in classical dance!

featured_reviews.name: meera jayachandran
featured_reviews.review_text: I feel truly grateful to be learning classical dance under Jyoti ma'am, who is such an experienced and inspiring teacher. Her years of expertise reflect in every class, from the precision in movements to the depth of expression she brings out in her students. What makes her truly special is her positive energy and the spiritual guidance she offers along the way. Every session feels not just like a dance class, but a beautiful journey of self-discovery and connection to tradition.  Highly recommended for anyone who wants to learn classical dance with authenticity, grace, and heart.

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Rani
featured_reviews.review_text: Jyoti mam is an accomplished dancer and really patient with her students. She’s also flexible about the schedule and that’s really helpful for working professionals.

featured_reviews.name: Dr.Anagha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm fortunate to have Jyoti mam as my classical dance teacher 🙏.
With her vast experience and expertise, she guides us from basics to advanced levels with utmost care, explaining the meaning behind each movement and word. Her inclusive teaching style and kindness make learning a delightful experience.
As my Guru, she's an exceptional instructor and a strong, inspiring woman. I'm grateful for her mentorship and look forward to learning from her as much as possible. Her passion, patience, and dedication make her classes truly special!
I'm sure you'll feel proud of Indian culture once you join her classes 😇.

featured_reviews.name: Anjali Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jyoti ma’am is definitely exceptional and experienced in her teaching. It’s been a few weeks since I started learning under her guidance and I always look forward to attending her classes during the week!

She’s quite patient and teaches with a lot of dedication. Her vast knowledge of Indian dance forms and fine techniques, makes the session absolutely enjoyable!

featured_reviews.name: lekshmy h
featured_reviews.review_text: I was going through considerable distress and was attending group therapy with mindtribe where, in one of the self care activities, dance was mentioned. Something instantly clicked and nrityahop came as a facebook ad for me. I took that as a sign from the universe and enrolled for their weekday evening batch to begin with. I could already see the difference because dance brought back the joy in me. Watching other people dance not only increased my confidence but also gave me tips to improve myself. When the weekday batch became hectic for me, I shifted to their weekend batch which polished my dance even further! The best part about nrityahop is they collaborate with other dance forms as well, so, I learnt several other dances too as a result! Thank you nrityahop for making me feel good about myself 😊

No one can stop there feet at Nrityahop Dance Studio✌

featured_reviews.review_text: I got in touch with Rupesh to be choreographed for my sangeet event.
